# CLI reference

Generated from the `basics` command tree.

## `basics`

Personal tech-stack vault shared with coding agents

```
basics [options] [command]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-V, --version` | output the version number | — |
| `-v, --vault <dir>` | vault directory (default: $BASICS_DIR, config "vault", or ~/basics-vault) | — |

### `basics config`

read or change the global basics config

```
basics config [options] [command]
```

No options.

#### `basics config path`

print the config file path

```
basics config path [options]
```

No options.

#### `basics config get`

print the config and the resolved vault directory

```
basics config get [options]
```

No options.

#### `basics config set`

set vault <dir>, language <en|es> or embeddings <true|false>

```
basics config set [options] <key> <value>
```

No options.

### `basics embeddings`

opt-in local embeddings and vector index

```
basics embeddings [options] [command]
```

No options.

#### `basics embeddings enable`

download the runtime and model, then index the vault

```
basics embeddings enable [options]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes` | skip the download confirmation | — |

#### `basics embeddings disable`

turn embeddings off (keeps the downloaded files)

```
basics embeddings disable [options]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--purge` | also delete the runtime and model cache | — |

#### `basics embeddings status`

show config, runtime, model cache and index state

```
basics embeddings status [options]
```

No options.

#### `basics embeddings reindex`

sync the vector index with the current vault

```
basics embeddings reindex [options]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--full` | re-embed every note | — |


| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--fix` | apply the fixes doctor knows how to make | — |

### `basics init`

create a vault and install note packs

```
basics init [options] [dir]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--lang <lang>` | note language (en\|es) | — |
| `--packs <names>` | comma-separated pack names, or none | — |
| `--yes` | accept defaults and install all packs | — |

### `basics connect`

register the Basics MCP server and skill with your coding agents

```
basics connect [options]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--client <names...>` | clients to register (claude-code, opencode, codex, cursor, claude-desktop); default: every client detected | — |
| `--transport <transport>` | stdio or http | `stdio` |
| `--port <n>` | port for the http transport | `4747` |
| `--no-skill` | do not install the Basics skill | — |
| `--dry-run` | print every change without writing anything | — |

### `basics export`

write STACK.md plus agent instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules) for a project

```
basics export [options] [dir]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-s, --stack <ids>` | comma-separated tech ids, e.g. fastapi,react,playwright | — |
| `-t, --targets <names>` | comma-separated targets (agents,claude,cursor) | — |
| `--detect` | detect the stack from package.json, pyproject.toml and requirements files | — |
| `--templates` | write check file templates that do not exist yet | — |
| `--dry-run` | print each file and whether it would change, without writing | — |

### `basics check`

run the stack checks of a project, trusting each command first

```
basics check [options] [dir]
```

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--only <ids>` | comma-separated check ids to run | — |
| `--list` | list checks, commands and trust state without running | — |
| `--trust` | trust and run every check without asking | — |
| `--timeout <s>` | per-check timeout in seconds | `600` |
| `--verbose` | stream command output | — |
| `--strict` | fail on skipped or untrusted checks too | — |
